title: Yellowstone Species Generator - trait dataset index

status_legend.extirpated_native: native, extirpated (e.g., Arctic grayling upper Madison)
status_legend.hypothetical: unconfirmed in park - labeled, never spawn
status_legend.not_in_park: wrong side of divide or excluded - reference only

site_fit_legend.midway_actor_ok: ecologically eligible for Midway Geyser Basin scene (still subject to catalogue review)
site_fit_legend.regional_expansion_only: YNP-documented but needs its own geography (per existing exclusion rules)
site_fit_legend.not_in_park: not eligible anywhere in park scene

gen_modes.parametric_mesh: code-built primitives driven by trait samples (existing wildlife_actor.gd approach)
gen_modes.deform_base: verified open-license base mesh + parametric reshape/retexture

sampling_contract: sex -> age (survivorship) -> growth(size) -> allometric proportions -> morph loci -> condition axes -> pattern -> seasonal overlay -> HSV jitter; deterministic per seed
hard_rules_carried: no species ID from mat color alone
no procedural spawning into scene (this dataset is a library, not a spawn list)
morph frequencies cite source+year; stale flagged
clonal plants vary by genet, not ramet
